title: DynamicFocalPO: Adaptive Focusing Strategy for Preference Optimization
authors_zh: Shu Zhou, Junan Chen, Rui Ling, Xin Wang, Tao Fan, Hao Wang（南京大学、百度、南京财经大学）
paper_type_zh: 基于课程学习的偏好优化研究
best_for_zh: 适合拥有离线偏好数据集，并希望以轻量方式控制含糊或排序错误的回答对何时影响 DPO 训练的读者。
one_line: DynamicFocalPO schedules preference-pair weighting from easy, already-correctly-ranked records toward harder records as training progresses.
DynamicFocalPO 随训练推进调度偏好回答对的权重：先侧重已正确排序的容易记录，再逐步纳入困难记录。
why: It makes training time an explicit part of how the optimizer consumes preference records instead of assigning every pair a fixed influence for the entire run.
inclusion_reason: It changes when and how much each existing preference record contributes to optimization, implementing an easy-to-hard curriculum through a scheduled record-level loss weight.

title: Problem
问题
html:
DPO uses the same preference pairs throughout a run, yet the model's relationship to those pairs changes as learning proceeds. Pairs that the implicit reward already ranks correctly can provide stable early supervision, while pairs it misranks can produce noisy or unhelpful gradients before the model has learned a basic preference boundary. A fixed focal weight assumes that this balance never changes.

DynamicFocalPO asks how an offline preference objective can control the timing of pair influence without recollecting labels or discarding hard examples forever. It treats learning stage as part of the decision about which records should dominate the update. The target is therefore the training use of an existing chosen-rejected dataset, not the construction of a replacement dataset.

DPO 在一次训练中持续使用相同的偏好回答对，但模型与这些回答对的关系会随学习推进而变化。隐式奖励已经正确排序的回答对能够提供稳定的早期监督，而它排序错误的回答对，在模型尚未学会基本偏好边界前可能产生嘈杂或无益的梯度。固定的焦点权重假定这种平衡从不改变。

DynamicFocalPO 询问如何在不重新收集标签、也不永久丢弃困难示例的情况下，让离线偏好目标控制回答对影响训练的时机。它把学习阶段视为决定哪些记录应主导更新的一部分。因此，它的目标是使用已有优劣回答对数据集的训练方式，而不是构建替代数据集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
DynamicFocalPO extends FocalPO by replacing its single focusing parameter with a schedule. A high early parameter sharply suppresses gradients from pairs whose implicit rewards are currently misranked, so optimization concentrates on pairs the model can already order correctly. As the parameter declines, the suppression weakens and those difficult pairs increasingly participate, bringing the objective closer to ordinary DPO.

This produces a curriculum without changing the stored preference records. The same record has different effective weight at different training times, determined by its current margin and the scheduled parameter. The authors compare linear, exponential, and cosine decay, and argue that cosine annealing yields a smoother transition from reliable signal to challenge examples than a fixed focal setting.

DynamicFocalPO 通过把 FocalPO 的单一焦点参数替换为日程来扩展它。较高的早期参数会强烈压制隐式奖励当前排序错误的回答对所产生的梯度，使优化集中于模型已经能够正确排序的回答对。随着参数下降，压制减弱，困难回答对逐渐参与，使目标更接近普通 DPO。

这在不改变已存偏好记录的条件下形成课程。相同记录在不同训练时刻具有不同的有效权重，由其当前间隔和日程参数共同决定。作者比较了线性、指数和余弦衰减，并认为余弦退火比固定焦点设置更平滑地从可靠信号过渡到挑战性示例。

title: Method
方法
html:
The loss retains DPO's implicit reward margin for a chosen and rejected response, then multiplies its contribution by a focal term with a time-dependent exponent. The authors set the exponent high at the beginning and reduce it toward a small value by the end; when it approaches zero, the modulating term approaches one and the update approaches DPO. Their gradient analysis identifies this as early selective suppression followed by later recovery of hard-pair gradients.

For the main experiments, they train Mistral-Base-7B on UltraFeedback and Llama-3-Instruct-8B on Llama3-ultrafeedback-armorm for one epoch with batch size 128. The reported shared schedule bounds are 0.10 and 0.01, with cosine, linear, and exponential variants; cosine is strongest. Baselines are DPO, SimPO, FocalPO with its published value, and a grid-tuned fixed FocalPO value, so the test isolates scheduling rather than a different data source.

该损失保留 DPO 对优选和劣选回答的隐式奖励间隔，再用带时间依赖指数的焦点项乘以其贡献。作者在开始时设置较高指数，并在结束时将其降至较小值；当它接近零，调制项接近一，更新也接近 DPO。其梯度分析将此解释为早期的选择性压制，以及之后困难回答对梯度的恢复。

主要实验中，他们以批大小 128 训练一个轮次：Mistral-Base-7B 使用 UltraFeedback，Llama-3-Instruct-8B 使用 Llama3-ultrafeedback-armorm。报告的共享日程边界为 0.10 和 0.01，并使用余弦、线性和指数变体；余弦最强。基线包括 DPO、SimPO、使用已发表数值的 FocalPO 和网格调优后的固定 FocalPO 数值，因此检验隔离了日程而非不同的数据来源。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
With cosine scheduling, the Llama 3 result reaches 56.4% length-controlled win rate on AlpacaEval 2.0 and 36.0% win rate on Arena-Hard, compared with 55.2% and 35.0% for the best tuned fixed FocalPO setting. For Mistral, it reports 24.1% length-controlled AlpacaEval win rate and 18.2% Arena-Hard win rate, above the best fixed counterpart at 22.9% and 17.3%. Main results are averaged over three seeds and the marked improvements over the best FocalPO setting are tested with paired t-tests.

The proposed training dynamic is also measured directly: the share of gradient contribution from correctly ranked pairs falls from 78% early in training to 47% late, close to DPO's roughly 46%, whereas fixed FocalPO remains near 61%. On five OpenLLM tasks, the Llama configuration has the best reported average, 66.4%, though GSM8K is 1.6 points below DPO and the paper says this difference is not statistically significant. These observations support a staged weighting interpretation, not a claim that every capability rises.

采用余弦日程时，Llama 3 在 AlpacaEval 2.0 上达到 56.4% 的长度控制胜率，在 Arena-Hard 上达到 36.0% 的胜率；调优最好的固定 FocalPO 设置分别为 55.2% 和 35.0%。对 Mistral，论文报告 24.1% 的长度控制 AlpacaEval 胜率和 18.2% 的 Arena-Hard 胜率，高于最佳固定对应项的 22.9% 和 17.3%。主结果在三个随机种子上取平均，并用配对 t 检验测试了相对于最佳 FocalPO 设置的标记改进。

论文还直接测量所提出的训练动态：正确排序回答对的梯度贡献占比从训练早期的 78% 降到晚期的 47%，接近 DPO 的约 46%，而固定 FocalPO 保持在约 61%。在五项 OpenLLM 任务上，Llama 配置拥有报告中最高的 66.4% 平均分，不过 GSM8K 比 DPO 低 1.6 分，论文称这一差异没有统计显著性。这些观察支持分阶段加权的解释，而不是所有能力都会提高的主张。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
FocalPO already suppresses poorly ranked pairs, but it applies that decision with the same strength for the entire run. DynamicFocalPO's new decision is temporal: a pair's current ranking and the training stage jointly determine its influence. This creates an optimizer-level curriculum without needing a separate difficulty annotator, a data ordering pass, or a new batch of preference examples.

The paper additionally derives how the schedule changes entropy regularization and gradient suppression, then verifies the intended shift in gradient-contribution ratios. This is more specific than simply annealing a generic hyperparameter: the schedule changes the effective consumer of the preference dataset from early reliable pairs to a broader set of pairs later. Its novelty is therefore about the training objective's evolving treatment of the same records.

FocalPO 已经会压制排序不佳的回答对，但它在整个训练中以相同强度执行这一决策。DynamicFocalPO 的新决策具有时间性：一个回答对的当前排序和训练阶段共同决定其影响力。这无需单独的难度标注器、数据排序流程或新的偏好示例批次，就形成了优化器层面的课程。

论文还推导了日程如何改变熵正则化和梯度压制，并验证了预期的梯度贡献比例转变。这比退火一个通用超参数更具体：该日程让偏好数据集的有效消费者从早期的可靠回答对变为后期更广泛的回答对集合。因此，它的新意在于训练目标对同一批记录不断演化的处理方式。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors explicitly limit evidence to 7B and 8B models and English tasks, leaving larger-scale and multilingual behavior unverified. The end points and shape of the schedule remain design choices, even though the reported cosine setting is robustly better than several fixed values in the tested setup. Because the method reweights rather than diagnoses records, it cannot tell whether an early-suppressed pair is mislabeled, genuinely difficult, or useful for an unmeasured capability; benchmark gains also rely on LLM judges for the two primary alignment evaluations.
作者明确将证据限制在 7B 和 8B 模型及英文任务上，因此更大规模和多语言行为尚未验证。尽管报告的余弦设置在测试方案中稳定优于多个固定数值，日程的端点和形状仍是设计选择。由于该方法重新加权而非诊断记录，它无法区分早期被压制的回答对是标签错误、确实困难，还是对未测能力有用；两个主要对齐评测的基准增益也依赖大模型评判器。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this method when preference data are fixed and quality varies over the course of DPO, but generating new data or running a costly selection model is impractical. It is a small integration point for a DPO-style trainer: retain the pairs, expose the current margin, and schedule the focal exponent. It is less suitable when the main problem is label corruption, domain coverage, or cultural representation, because it changes pair influence rather than repairing or diversifying the underlying records.
当偏好数据固定、其质量随 DPO 过程而变化，但生成新数据或运行昂贵选择模型并不现实时，可使用这一方法。它是 DPO 风格训练器中的一个小型集成点：保留回答对、暴露当前间隔，并调度焦点指数。当主要问题是标签损坏、领域覆盖或文化代表性时，它不太适合，因为它改变的是回答对的影响力，而不是修复或丰富底层记录。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the gradient plot and Equation 7 after the DPO background: the important distinction is not a new label but a changing gradient weight for a known pair. Table 1 is the main empirical comparison and should be read against both the published and tuned fixed FocalPO settings. Then use the contribution-ratio analysis and the OpenLLM table as safeguards against an overly simple “easy first is always better” reading: the schedule deliberately gives difficult pairs more influence later, and the reported GSM8K result is not an improvement over DPO.
在阅读 DPO 背景之后阅读梯度图和公式 7：关键区别不是新的标签，而是已知回答对不断变化的梯度权重。表 1 是主要实证比较，应同时与已发表和调优后的固定 FocalPO 设置对照阅读。随后把贡献比例分析和 OpenLLM 表作为防止过度简化“先易后难总是更好”解读的保障：该日程刻意让困难回答对在后期拥有更大影响，报告的 GSM8K 结果也没有优于 DPO。

Instruction, preferred response, dispreferred response, implicit reward margin, time-dependent focusing parameter, and loss weight.
The paper consumes existing chosen-rejected preference pairs rather than generating new traces.
Offline preference optimization using DPO-style updates.
Existing preference labels define the chosen-rejected ordering; no new reward model is introduced.
Begin by strongly suppressing misranked pairs and progressively allow them to affect optimization as the focusing parameter decays.
Mistral-Base-7B or Llama-3-Instruct-8B in the reported experiments.
Existing UltraFeedback-derived preference labels; no additional teacher is needed.
No generation stage is required by the method.
One epoch with batch size 128 in the main setups; the paper compares linear, exponential, and cosine schedules.
Not applicable because the method trains on existing preference pairs.
Not a central reported control variable.
A time-varying focal factor reweights each preference pair according to its current implicit ranking; it is weighting rather than hard record removal.
No extra response-generation or reward-model inference is introduced beyond the selected preference datasets and benchmark judges.
DynamicFocalPO, a scheduled extension of FocalPO and DPO.
Public UltraFeedback-derived preference datasets for two base-model settings.
AlpacaEval 2.0 and Arena-Hard use external judges; OpenLLM tasks assess general capability; main results average three random seeds.
No broad contamination audit is reported.
